policy.rule: singleton note may move exactly one octave down only when both immediate neighboring onset groups support the lower voice and local voice-leading cost improves by at least eight semitones

interpretation: Local voice continuity can safely recover some Basic Pitch octave errors without adding events or reading the reference. Bend-start omission remains independent and unresolved.
limitations: This is development evidence on the generic guitar oracle and reviewed rhythm reference; it is not final customer accuracy.
The rule was evaluated on already reviewed development material and requires prospective validation on other songs before product use.
Generic guitar isolation still does not establish rhythm-versus-lead separation.
